title: the @MetOpera first-ever superhero opera?? i’m obsessed. 🦸🏻‍♂️ #metop...
transcript: A superhero opera? As a new-ish opera fan I never would have expected to see comic books and opera in the same sentence and yet somehow the Metropolitan Opera has made it not just work but feel like it was always meant to be I was invited to opening night at The Met to see the world premiere of The Amazing Adventures of Kavalier and Clay based on the Pulitzer Prize winning novel I love the Metropolitan Opera I think it is one of the most beautiful buildings in the city the energy at opening night was incredible everyone looked stunning and this opera was so unique and ambitious The Amazing Adventures of Kavalier and Clay is about two Jewish cousins in 1939 and together they create a superhero called The Escapist who fights facism it's got everything drama heartbreak queer love and hope It's directed by Bartlett Sher and this production lands at such an important moment a story about rising fascism and the way artists respond could not be more timely or more resonant the show also has incredible effects and projections. The comics literally come to life before your eyes In The Met's 142 year history this is the first opera that centers a comic book superhero if you love opera this production is so fresh and innovative and if you've never been to an opera this is the perfect entry point and the music is so cinematic and lush but with some really fun surprises I would not have expected in opera truly The Met orchestra must be experienced The is only the first show in The Met's 2025-2026 season which will have 18 productions including six new to The Met but I can't think of a better way to kick off a season than this you have until October 11th to see it what a special special special special night
reasoning: The reviewer attended opening night and gives an enthusiastic recommendation, praising the music, production, effects, direction, and timeliness. Clear urging to see it before it closes.
